Our Story

Started in a garage. Built at the markets. Home in Beaumont.

Kiersten started Cloud Nine at 18 years old, in her garage — one machine, a clean-ingredient rule, and a belief that a small town deserved better coffee. Three and a half years of market mornings later, the storefront opened on Beaumont Ave — same menu, same rule, same trailer still rolling.
